code_hints: After initial navigation, attempt clicking consent: querySelector('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler')?.click(); also dismiss any generic close buttons with aria-label='Close'.
Wait up to 8-10s for any of the PLP grid selectors. If none appear or grid has zero tiles, navigate to the fallback PLP URL provided in overrides_patch.start_url.
Implement a gentle scroll (e.g., window.scrollBy(0, window.innerHeight) in a loop) to trigger lazy loading for tiles; re-evaluate tiles after scrolling.
Extract PDP links from the first matching tile selector list; prefer anchors ending with .html and within /en-jp/. De-duplicate and filter using url_rules.allow/block.
On PDP, wait for either price selectors or an 'Add to cart' button before reading title/price to avoid partial loads.
Set a modern desktop Chrome User-Agent and keep Accept-Language as en-JP to minimize locale modals/redirect loops.
rationale: We landed on the Moncler homepage (/en-jp/) which is not a PLP, so no product tiles materialized. Moncler commonly gates content with OneTrust cookies and may show modals. The overrides force entry into a stable PLP (men/ready-to-wear/down-jackets), add cookie/modal handling, and broaden PLP/PDP selectors to match SFCC-style product grids. URL normalization prevents homepage loops and misroutes (e.g., monclergroup.com, editorial pages).
